mapper.sql: application_id, user_id, source_type, analysis_id, simulation_id, ai_scenario_id, guidance_id, applied_guidance_action, applied_investment_frequency, applied_recurring_contribution_amount, applied_monthly_saving_amount, applied_monthly_investment_amount, applied_expected_return_rate, applied_monthly_spending_amount, before_expected_asset, after_expected_asset, applied_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO strategy_application ( user_id, source_type, analysis_id, simulation_id, ai_scenario_id, guidance_id, applied_guidance_action, applied_investment_frequency, applied_recurring_contribution_amount, applied_monthly_saving_amount, applied_monthly_investment_amount, applied_expected_return_rate, applied_monthly_spending_amount, before_expected_asset, after_expected_asset ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{sourceType}, #{analysisId}, #{simulationId}, #{aiScenarioId}, #{guidanceId}, #{appliedGuidanceAction}, #{appliedInvestmentFrequency}, #{appliedRecurringContributionAmount}, #{appliedMonthlySavingAmount}, #{appliedMonthlyInvestmentAmount}, #{appliedExpectedReturnRate}, #{appliedMonthlySpendingAmount}, #{beforeExpectedAsset}, #{afterExpectedAsset} ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE application_id = LAST_INSERT_ID(application_id), ai_scenario_id = #{aiScenarioId}, applied_monthly_saving_amount = #{appliedMonthlySavingAmount}, applied_monthly_investment_amount = #{appliedMonthlyInvestmentAmount}, applied_expected_return_rate = #{appliedExpectedReturnRate}, applied_monthly_spending_amount = #{appliedMonthlySpendingAmount}, before_expected_asset = #{beforeExpectedAsset}, applied_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
mapper.select: SELECT FROM strategy_application WHERE guidance_id = #{guidanceId} AND user_id = #{userId} AND source_type = 'INVESTMENT_GUIDANCE' ORDER BY applied_at DESC, application_id DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT FROM strategy_application WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY applied_at DESC, application_id DESC LIMIT 1
